description:
Rewrite this checkout's active leases once from `claims.index.json` into per-issue lease records and remove the index, so no lease held at cutover is lost.

## Background

This checkout's `.git/jit/` holds `claims.index.json` with the active leases, `claims.jsonl` with about 1,800 history lines, and an empty leftover `heartbeat/` directory. The released binary reads leases only from `.git/jit/leases/<issue-id>.json`, takes sequence numbers from `.git/jit/claims.seq`, and never reads the index. The data is machine-local and not committed.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A script under `dev/active/f8a6b298-history-independent-reads/` writes each unexpired lease of the index to `.git/jit/leases/<issue-id>.json` in the lease record shape, seeds `claims.seq` from the log's highest sequence number, and removes `claims.index.json` and the empty `heartbeat/` directory. It leaves `claims.jsonl` byte-for-byte unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-02: The script is idempotent: a second run changes nothing.
- [hard] REQ-03: `jit claim list --json` reports the same leases after the rewrite as before it, and repository validation passes.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: This checkout's leases are rewritten into lease records
